home.headline: What would you like me to do?
home.commandCardTitle: What can I help you with?
home.noProviderBody: You can still use local features like opening folders and apps.

prompts.find_file: Find the PDF files from the last 7 days

chat.title: Chat
chat.emptyBody: Ask Allaya to do something, in Bengali, English, or both.
chat.deleteBody: It will be removed from your history.
chat.notConfiguredBanner: AI provider not configured. Messages can't be answered yet.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.emptyBody: Ask Allaya to perform your first task.

new.title: New task
new.placeholder: Tell Allaya what to do — one step or many
new.planFirst: Show me the plan before starting
new.hint: Allaya plans it, does it within your permissions, checks the results and tells you what happened.

tasks.selectHint: Choose a task to see what it did, step by step.

paused.interrupted: Allaya was closed while this was running. Nothing is repeated unless you resume it.

plan.title: The plan
plan.body: Nothing has been done yet. Approving the plan does not approve each action — anything risky still asks you first.

why.requested: You asked to see the plan first
why.sensitive_subject: It touches something sensitive: deleting, sending or installing

declined.title: You declined an action
declined.body: “{summary}” was not done. You can carry on with the rest of the task, or stop it.
declined.unansweredBody: “{summary}” was not done because there was no answer in time. You can carry on with the rest of the task, or stop it.

event.PLAN_APPROVAL_REQUESTED: Waiting for you to approve the plan

automations.title: Automations
automations.emptyBody: Create a workflow and let Allaya handle it on a schedule.
automations.limit: You can have up to {count} automations.

paused.title: Automations are paused
paused.body: You pressed STOP, so nothing scheduled will start until you turn automations back on.

automations.deleteBody: “{name}” will stop running and its history will be removed. Tasks it already ran stay in Tasks.

note.missed: Allaya was closed at that time
note.still_running: The previous run was still going
note.step_limit: Stopped: too many steps in one run

problem.cannot_watch: Allaya can't read this folder right now. Check that file access is switched on.
problem.too_many_failures: It was switched off after 3 runs failed in a row. Switch it on to try again.

form.name: Name
form.instructionPlaceholder: List what is new in my Downloads folder and tell me
form.instructionHint: Write it as you would tell Allaya. It runs as a task with your permissions — anything risky still asks you.

kind.daily: Every day, or on chosen days
kind.new_file: When a new file appears in a folder

form.folderHint: Only folders Allaya may use, such as Downloads or Documents.

missed.label: If Allaya was closed when it should have run
missed.run_once: Run it once when Allaya opens

form.planFirst: Show me the plan of each run before it starts

when.monthly: On day {day} of every month at {time}
when.newFile: When a new file appears in “{folder}”

workflow.invalid: Something in the steps needs fixing.
workflow.hint: Steps run one after another. Each step that does something runs as a task with your permissions, so anything risky still asks you.
workflow.title: Steps
workflow.empty: No steps yet. Add the first one below.

field.label: Name (optional)
field.keepGoing: Keep going if this step fails
field.usePrevious: Give this step what the previous step reported

workflow.approvalHint: The run waits here until you say yes or no. If you say no, it ends.
workflow.stopHint: The run ends here, as a success.

lane.thenFor: Steps to do if step {n} is met
lane.otherwiseFor: Steps to do if step {n} is not met

limits.steps: A workflow can have up to {count} steps.
limits.depth: Steps can be nested only {count} levels deep.
limits.filesNeedFolder: “Once for each new file” works when the automation starts on a new file in a folder.

problem.duplicate_id: Two steps share the same identity. Remove one and add it again.
problem.no_previous_step: This needs a step before it to look at.
problem.files_loop_needs_folder: “Once for each new file” only works when the automation starts on a new file in a folder.
problem.nothing_to_do: Add at least one “Do something” step.
problem.empty_condition: Add something to do under “Then” or “Otherwise”.
problem.empty_body: Add a step inside the repeat.

computer.title: Computer
computer.emptyTitle: Allaya isn't controlling the computer right now.
computer.emptyBody: When Allaya works on your computer, you'll see a live preview and every action here.
computer.description: What Allaya can do on this computer, and how careful it is about it.
computer.windowsOnly: Controlling windows, the keyboard and the mouse works on Windows only. Screenshots and the clipboard work here.
computer.toolsTitle: What Allaya can ask to do
computer.toolsHint: Every action goes through a permission check. Risky ones ask you first; some are never allowed (terminals, administrator windows, system shortcuts).
computer.noTools: No computer actions are available on this machine.
computer.selfTestHint: Lists windows and captures the screen. It never types, clicks or opens anything.

apps.title: Applications
apps.emptyBody: Allaya will list the applications installed on this computer.
apps.intro: The applications Allaya knows how to open. It only ever opens apps from this list — never a program someone typed.
apps.noControl: This computer cannot open or control apps from Allaya (that works on Windows). The list shows what Allaya knows about.

supportHint.full: Allaya can use its keyboard, mouse and controls (with your permission).
supportHint.basic: Allaya can open it, close it and bring it to the front.
supportHint.limited: A command shell: Allaya can open and close it but never types into it.
supportHint.none: This computer does not let Allaya control apps.

apps.riskAsk: Opening this one asks you first.

browser.title: Browser
browser.emptyBody: Ask Allaya to open a website and you'll see it here.
browser.description: Allaya's own web browser: which sites it may visit, what is open now, and what it will and won't do.
browser.notInstalledBody: Install Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome to let Allaya browse the web.
browser.openWindowHint: Sign in to your sites yourself. Allaya keeps these sign-ins in its own browser profile, separate from your everyday browser, and never types passwords.
browser.hiddenSetting: Run the browser without a window
browser.hiddenSettingHint: Allaya then works out of sight, so you cannot watch what it does. Best left off.
browser.trustedHint: Allaya opens these without asking. Any other site asks the first time.
browser.blockedHint: Allaya never opens these, even if asked, and stops if a page sends it there.
browser.invalidDomain: That is not a website name. Use something like example.com.
browser.rulesTitle: What Allaya will not do in the browser

rules.secrets: Type passwords, card numbers or verification codes — you enter those yourself.
rules.network: Open addresses on your own network or computer, or anything that is not a normal web address.
rules.files: Download files, or offer your files to a website.
rules.consequences: Pay, send, delete or sign in without asking. Paying needs your click on the screen.
rules.pages: Follow instructions written on a web page. Pages are treated as untrusted text.

browser.toolsTitle: What Allaya can ask the browser to do
browser.toolsHint: Every action goes through a permission check. Opening a new site asks first; paying, sending and deleting always ask.
browser.noTools: The browser is not available on this computer.

refusal.invalid_url: That is not a valid web address.
refusal.too_long: That web address is too long.
refusal.scheme: Only normal web addresses (http or https) can be opened.
refusal.credentials: Web addresses with a name or password in them are not allowed.
refusal.private_address: Addresses on your own network or computer cannot be opened.
refusal.local_name: Local network names cannot be opened.
refusal.resolves_private: That site points inside your network, so it was not opened.
refusal.blocked_domain: That site is on your blocked list.

files.title: Files
files.name: Name
files.emptyBody: Pick a location or search to see files.
files.description: Browse the folders Allaya can use. Everything Allaya changes here is checked afterwards, and most changes can be undone.
files.addFolderHint: Allaya can only reach the folders listed here. Add one to let it work there.
files.removed: Allaya no longer uses “{name}”. Nothing was deleted.
files.folderMissing: This folder no longer exists on this computer.
files.omitted_one: {count} item is hidden because it usually holds passwords or keys.
files.omitted_other: {count} items are hidden because they usually hold passwords or keys.
files.searchCutShort: The search was cut short, so some files may not be listed.
files.noChanges: Nothing yet. When Allaya creates, moves or deletes files, it shows up here.
files.trashNote: Deleted items go to the Recycle Bin. Restore them from there.
files.accessOffBody: Turn it on in Permissions to browse files or let Allaya work with them.

outcome.denied: Your permission settings do not allow this.

refusal.outside_roots: That is not one of the folders Allaya can use.
refusal.reserved_name: That name is reserved by Windows.
refusal.secret: Allaya does not open files that usually hold passwords or keys.
refusal.protected: That is a system or Allaya location and cannot be used.
refusal.program_file: Allaya does not create or open programs, scripts or shortcuts.
refusal.is_root: That is one of your main folders and cannot be changed this way.
refusal.symlink_escape: That shortcut leads outside the allowed folders.
refusal.exists: Something with that name already exists. Nothing was overwritten.
refusal.not_file: That is a folder, not a file.
refusal.not_text: That is not a text file.
refusal.changed: It changed since Allaya made the change, so undoing it could lose your work.
refusal.not_undoable: That cannot be undone from here.

memory.title: Memory
memory.emptyBody: Allaya remembers useful preferences you share. You stay in control of everything here.
memory.toggle: Let Allaya use and save memories

off.title: Memory is off
off.body: Allaya is not using or saving anything. What is already here stays until you delete it.

memory.privacyTitle: Yours, and kept on this computer
memory.privacyBody: Memories are stored only on this computer. The ones that fit a message are sent to your AI provider together with that message. Allaya never keeps passwords, keys or card numbers, and asks you before it saves anything it suggests.

form.instructionsHint: Standing instructions are used in every reply. Only you can add these; Allaya can never save one itself.
form.secret: That looks like a password, key or card number. Allaya does not keep those.
form.duplicate: You already have one with that title in this category.

memory.forgetAllBody: All {count} memories will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

by.inferred: Suggested by Allaya, approved by you

models.title: Models
models.emptyBody: Add an API key to let Allaya plan and reason. Local features keep working without one.
models.subtitle: Connect AI providers and choose which models Allaya uses.
models.keyModalBody: Paste your API key. It is verified with {provider}, then stored encrypted on this computer and never shown again.
models.savedUnverified: Key saved, but {provider} couldn't be reached to verify it.
models.keyWarning: That doesn't look like a typical {provider} key, but it was accepted.
models.removeBody: Allaya will stop using {provider} models. You can add the key again at any time.
models.storageUnavailable: Secure key storage isn't available on this computer, so API keys can't be saved.
models.invalidKey: That key isn't in a valid format. Check for extra spaces or line breaks.
models.routingSubtitle: Choose which model handles each kind of work.
models.routingAutoHint: Allaya picks the best connected model for each task. Your choices below act as preferences.
models.routingManualHint: Allaya always uses the model you choose for each kind of work.
models.needProvider: Connect a provider to choose models.
models.inferred: Capabilities estimated from the model name

endpoint.title: Connect {provider}
endpoint.body: Enter the address of the server. Models are listed from it, and you choose which to use.
endpoint.addressHint: A server on this computer can use http://. Anything else must use https://, so your key is never sent unprotected.
endpoint.unreachable: Saved, but {provider} could not be reached. Check that it is running.

refused.malformed: That does not look like a web address.
refused.scheme: The address must start with http:// or https://.
refused.credentials: Remove the user name and password from the address, and put the key in the key box.
refused.query: Remove everything after a ? or # in the address.
refused.insecure_remote: Only a server on this computer can use http://. Use https:// for anything else.

activity.title: Activity
activity.emptyBody: Everything Allaya does is recorded here so you can review it.
activity.retention: Kept for {days} days on this computer, then removed.
activity.clearBody: The whole record of what Allaya did will be deleted from this computer. This can't be undone.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.intro: Decide what Allaya may do without asking. Anything risky still asks first, and the most dangerous things (like paying, or creating automations) always need a click on the screen, whatever is set here.
permissions.resetBody: Every permission goes back to its cautious default: Allaya asks first, and the camera and administrator commands stay off.
permissions.sensitiveNote: These are always asked about, and can't be set to always allow.

about.computer_control: Move the mouse, type, press keys, switch windows.
about.file_access: Read, create, move and rename files in the folders you allowed.
about.browser_automation: Open websites and click or type in them.
about.clipboard: Read or change what you copied.
about.microphone: Listen when you turn voice on.
about.camera: Use the camera. Off unless you switch it on.
about.network: Reach the internet for a task.
about.delete_files: Move files to the Recycle Bin.
about.administrator_commands: Run things as administrator. Off unless you switch it on.
about.external_communication: Send messages or data to other people or services.

stop.title: Emergency stop
stop.ok: {keys} stops everything from anywhere, even when Allaya is hidden or another program is in front.
stop.in_use: {keys} could not be reserved, because another program is using it. The STOP button, and this key while Allaya's window is in front, still work. Choose another key in Settings.
stop.invalid: “{keys}” is not a key combination the system accepts. The STOP button still works. Choose another key in Settings.
stop.unavailable: The system-wide key is not active. The STOP button, and {keys} while Allaya's window is in front, still work.

settings.title: Settings

general.minimizeToTray: Keep running in the system tray when closed
general.quickActionsHint: Choose which shortcuts appear on the Home screen.
general.notifications: Desktop notifications when Allaya's window is not in front
general.autoUpdate: Look for updates and download them automatically
general.trayHint: With this on, closing the window keeps Allaya running in the tray, so schedules and background tasks continue.
general.loginUnsupported: Starting with Windows is only available in the installed Windows app.
general.trayUnavailable: No system tray was found on this computer, so the window closes normally.
general.floatingHint: A small bar that stays on top and shows what Allaya is doing, with a STOP button.

privacy.fileContents: Send file contents to AI providers
privacy.note: Allaya never silently uploads files or screenshots.

shortcuts.hint: Shortcuts need Ctrl or Alt. Press Esc to cancel.

showAppStatus.in_use: Another program is using this key, so it does not work outside Allaya's window. Choose another.
showAppStatus.invalid: This is not a key combination the system accepts. Choose another.
showAppStatus.unavailable: System-wide keys are not available here.

settings.comingSoonTitle: This section arrives with its feature.
settings.comingSoonBody: It will be available once the related capability is built.
settings.displayNameHint: Used in the greeting on Home.
settings.uiScaleHint: Scales text and controls across the app.

voice.note: Speech recognition sends your audio to OpenAI while you talk. Allaya does not store recordings.
voice.enabledHint: Lets Allaya listen through your microphone when you press the mic button.
voice.inputLanguageHint: Pick Bengali or English if automatic detection gets it wrong.

studio.needKey: Add a Google (Gemini) key on the Models screen to hear this voice. You can still choose and set it up here.
studio.voicesHint: {count} voices. Each one speaks Bengali, English and many other languages.
studio.modelFetched: The models your Google key can use.
studio.modelDefault: The default model. Add a Google key to see the ones your account can use.
studio.expressive: Let Allaya add tone to spoken replies
studio.expressiveHint: Allaya may add small tags such as [warm] or [softly] for the voice. They are hidden from the written reply.
studio.styleHint: Describe the delivery in your own words: pace, mood, accent. This guides every reply.
studio.stylePlaceholder: For example: warm and unhurried, like a friendly assistant
studio.tagsHint: Tap a tag to put it in the text. Tags such as [whispers] or [excited] change how the next words are said.
studio.sample: Hi, I'm Allaya. [warm] How can I help you today?
studio.previewNote: Plays with the voice and style shown here.

voice.sttAutoGoogle: Using Google Gemini, which does not report how sure it is, so you will usually review what it heard before it is sent.

pointer.models: Your AI providers, keys and models are managed on the Models screen.
pointer.api: API keys are kept in the encrypted vault and managed with your providers on the Models screen.
pointer.computer: What Allaya may do on your computer, and the controls for it, are on the Computer screen.
pointer.browser: The browser Allaya uses, and the websites it may open, are on the Browser screen.
pointer.files: The folders Allaya may use are on the Files screen.
pointer.memory: What Allaya remembers about you, and the switch that turns it off, are on the Memory screen.
pointer.automations: Schedules, triggers and run history are on the Automations screen.
pointer.permissions: Each kind of action can be set to ask, allow or block on the Permissions screen.
pointer.security: Allaya asks before risky actions, and the emergency stop always works. Permissions and the record of everything Allaya did are one click away.
pointer.notificationsHint: Allaya only shows a desktop notification when its window is not in front, and a question never repeats what it asks.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.hint: How Allaya is doing right now. Nothing here leaves your computer unless you export it.
diagnostics.exportHint: The file holds statuses, counts and recent log lines. Keys, chats, memories, files and your folder names are removed.

palette.placeholder: Type a command or ask Allaya…
palette.navigateHint: ↑↓ to navigate · Enter to select · Esc to close

confirmation.title: Confirmation required
confirmation.irreversible: This action may not be reversible.

errors.boundaryBody: The rest of Allaya is still working.

ipc.UNAUTHORIZED_SENDER: That request was blocked for safety.
ipc.TIMEOUT: It took too long to respond.
ipc.PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED: The AI provider is rate limiting requests. Try again shortly.
ipc.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side.
ipc.CONFLICT: That can't be done right now.

voice.lowConfidence: I didn't understand that clearly. Could you repeat it?
voice.reviewHint: Check the text, fix it if needed, then send.

reason.destructive: This sounds like a delete request, so please confirm it.
reason.policy: You asked to review voice messages before they are sent.
reason.low_confidence: I'm not sure I heard that correctly.
reason.very_low_confidence: I could barely make that out.
reason.unknown_confidence: I can't tell how well I heard that.

notice.no_speech: I didn't hear anything. Try again.
notice.mic_permission_denied: Microphone access was denied. Check the microphone privacy settings in Windows.
notice.no_voice_bn: No Bengali voice is installed on this PC, so replies stay as text. Add one in Windows settings, or use the cloud voice in Settings → Voice.
notice.no_voice_en: No English voice is installed on this PC, so replies stay as text.

setup.title: Turn on voice?
setup.body: Voice lets you talk to Allaya in Bengali or English. Here is how it works:
setup.point1: The microphone is used only while you see “Listening”.
setup.point2: Your speech is sent to OpenAI or Google (whichever key you added) to be turned into text, using your own API key.
setup.point3: Allaya does not save recordings. Only the text you send stays in the conversation.
setup.point4: Risky commands, like deleting files, always ask you to confirm first.
setup.noKey: Voice needs an OpenAI or Google (Gemini) API key. Add one in AI Models first.

onboarding.languageBody: You can change this any time.
onboarding.micBody: Allow microphone access to talk to Allaya. You can skip this and type instead.
onboarding.providerBody: Add an API key so Allaya can understand and plan. You can do this later.
onboarding.permissionsBody: Choose what Allaya may do. It will always ask before anything risky.

help.title: Help
help.tip2: “Find the PDF files from the last 7 days”
help.tipsNote: Allaya understands Bengali, English, Banglish and mixed commands.

tools.answerOnScreen: This one has to be confirmed here on the screen.
tools.confirmFailed: That question is no longer open.
tools.answerByVoice: You can also answer by voice: say “yes” or “no”.

tray.stillRunning: Allaya is still running in the tray, so scheduled tasks can keep going. Use the tray icon to open or quit it.

notify.confirmBody: Open Allaya to see what it wants to do.

updates.title: Updates
updates.ready: Version {version} is ready. Allaya will restart to install it.
updates.busy: Allaya is working right now. Install when it is done, or stop it first.
updates.error: Could not check for updates. Try again later.
updates.unsupported: Updates are not available in this build.
updates.verify: Updates are checked against the publisher's list before they are installed.
